text.p: A woman convicted of throwing acid into the faces of her estranged lover's wife and the woman's eight-year-old daughter was executed in Shanghai on Tuesday, the city's Xinmin Evening News reported.
A city court issued the execution order for Yang Yuxia on Tuesday morning. She was immediately taken to the execution ground where the sentence was carried out, it said.
Shanghai television showed footage of a weeping Yang giving testimony at her trial, just a few feet away from her victim, disfigured and swathed in bandages.
